primaryChecks.text: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Then Joram crossed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him; and he rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him with the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

primaryChecks.text: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
primaryChecks.previousContext: His servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

primaryChecks.text: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
primaryChecks.previousContext: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
